title.en: AIRPORT PASSENGER SERVICE CHARGE AMENDMENT OF SCHEDULE ORDER 2017

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-29_2017_E-AIRPORT-PASSENGER-SERVICE-CHARGE-AMENDMENT-OF-SCHEDULE-ORDER-2017.pdf》（2 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Airport Passenger Service Charge [Amendment of Schedule) Order, 2017 and shall commence on 1st April 2017. Substitution of Schedule to Chapter 188

The Airport Passenger Service Charge Act is amended by repealing the Schedule and by substituting the following new Schedule therefor - "SCHEDULE [section 2) Passengers embarking for destinations in ASEAN Member States $12 Passengers embarking for other destinations $20". Made this 2nd. day of Rejab, 1438 Hijriah corresponding to the 30th. day of March, 2017.

DATO SERI SETIA AWANG HAJI MUSTAPPA

BIN HAJI SIRAT Minister of Communications, Brunei Darussalam.
